name: caseledger
description: Collaborative case and evidence tracking with a verifiable audit trail.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix apps/web && npm install --prefix apps/audit-worker && npm install --prefix apps/graphql-gateway
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,gateway,web "dotnet watch --project apps/api --urls http://localhost:5150" "npm run dev --prefix apps/graphql-gateway" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.build: dotnet build CaseLedger.slnx && npm run build --prefix apps/graphql-gateway && npm run build --prefix apps/web && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/audit-worker
scripts.test: dotnet test CaseLedger.slnx && npm test --prefix apps/graphql-gateway && npm test --prefix apps/web && npm test --prefix tools/audit-verifier && npm test --prefix apps/audit-worker && npm test --prefix tools/webhook-receiver
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
